description: The quarterly 13F holdings of the fund managers InsiderRadar follows (e.g. Berkshire Hathaway, Baupost): give fund for one manager's positions in a quarter, or issuer for which followed managers held a company. Each position has the shares and value in USD this quarter and the previous one, whether it is new, increased, decreased, sold out or unchanged, and its share of everything the fund reported. Default quarter: each fund's latest report. Holdings at quarter end, filed up to 45 days later; no prices paid, no short positions, no cash.

fund.description: Part of the fund's name or its figurehead (Berkshire, Buffett, Baupost), or its SEC CIK.

issuer.description: Part of the company name as the fund reports it, e.g. Apple.

limit.description: How many positions to return, largest value first. Default 25.

quarter.description: The quarter end, e.g. 2026-06-30. Default: each fund's latest report.

status.description: Only new, increased, decreased, exited (sold out) or unchanged positions. Default all.

name: get_fund_holdings
title: Holdings of followed fund managers (SEC Form 13F)
